title: Beta-weighted non-local differential operators and related stochastic processes
summary: In this work we introduce a class of non-local differential operators defined through a beta-weighted averaging of the ordinary derivative. We investigate their analytical properties and establish connections with the Caputo and Erdélyi-Kober operators. Differential equations involving the beta-weighted derivative are studied by Mellin transform methods, leading to solutions represented in terms of Barnes G-functions and a new class of G-hypergeometric functions.
